review.notes: AegeanWorks cube motif branding for CardMon approved

BEFORE at be1c6ca: the 7 KPI cards in an auto-fit 6-column grid leave a 6+1 layout; the seventh 'En Yakın Ödeme' card occupies only ~175px of a ~1120px row, leaving a large empty void. This pushes the cashflow widget down and keeps the analytics chart cards below the fold. Text, spacing and contrast are otherwise clean; this dead space is the targeted issue.

AFTER at e3e5721: the seventh KPI is now a full-width horizontal strip (label+icon left, value center, meta right, rose accent line across) with no dead space. Cashflow widget shifts up and both analytics chart cards now appear in the 1440x900 viewport - better information density and scannability. No clipping, truncation or contrast regressions; typography and card geometry intact. Desktop-only media query leaves the <=1300px and 2-column mobile grids unchanged.

BEFORE at 78fd98e: empty portfolio (0 cards/limits) but the health widget shows a blue 'İYİ / DENGELİ' pill with a 70% colored bar, and its caption tells the user to click 'Yeni Kart Ekle' / 'Örnek Veri Yükle' buttons that are not visible on this screen. No next action is offered in the hero, leaving the empty state misleading and passive. Layout and typography otherwise clean.

AFTER at 432f4c6: the hero now offers two compact, clearly styled CTAs - 'Örnek Veri Yükle' (primary) and 'Yeni Kart Ekle' (secondary) - that are visible and actionable; the health widget shows an honest neutral 'VERİ YOK' pill, an empty progress track, and accurate guidance. Hero grows slightly and KPIs shift down but nothing clips or truncates; typography, card geometry and contrast remain clean. Empty state is now functional and self-explanatory; buttons hide automatically once data exists (guarded in renderHealthScoreWidget).

BEFORE at 8c03756: the empty-state hero offers 'Örnek Veri Yükle' and 'Yeni Kart Ekle'. The latter opens the card form, but its bank dropdown is populated only from state.banks (renderBankDropdowns), so with zero banks it is a dead-end first step; the health caption also tells the user to add a card first. Layout, spacing and typography are otherwise clean with no clipping.

AFTER at 59f9f76: the secondary CTA is now 'Yeni Banka Ekle' with a bank icon, opening the banks tab and bank modal - a valid first step; the health caption mentions banks first in both TR and EN. Visual rhythm of the hero is unchanged: no clipping, truncation or contrast regressions, badge/title/subtitle/CTA alignment intact. The empty-state guidance is now functionally correct and internally consistent with the app's bank-then-card onboarding flow.

BEFORE at 4e87eb3: empty portfolio is functional, but all seven zero-value KPI cards carry vivid top accent lines and bright icons, and the health widget shows a meaningless empty grey progress track. These compete with the two onboarding CTAs for attention; caption is small muted grey. Layout, spacing and typography otherwise clean.

AFTER at e44d534: zero-value KPI accent lines and icons are visibly subdued and the empty health bar is removed, so the blue onboarding CTA and the cashflow figures lead the eye; health caption is slightly larger and more legible. No clipping, truncation or contrast regressions; typography, card geometry and alignment unchanged. A calm, minimalist empty state that keeps all information available - G-001/G-003 satisfied.

BEFORE at 3fb8bb9: the full-width 'En Yakın Ödeme' strip places its value immediately after the icon on the left, leaving the wide middle empty while the meta sits at the far right - the row reads as lopsided despite the earlier full-width fix. All other layout, typography and spacing clean; no clipping.

AFTER at e36754e: the strip value is centered between the label/icon group on the left and the meta on the right, yielding a balanced three-part status bar. Confirmed the dash moved from the left cluster to the row center; no clipping, truncation or contrast regressions and no other visual changes. Cleaner information hierarchy for the full-width KPI strip.

BEFORE at b6a9913: the hero subtitle says limits, reserves and payment projections 'are summarized below' although the portfolio has zero banks/cards and every metric is empty. It also wraps to two lines, making the hero taller than needed. Layout, typography and CTA styling are otherwise clean.

AFTER at 01b1d67: the empty-state subtitle now reads 'Banka veya kart ekledikçe limit, borç ve ödeme özetleri burada görünür' - accurate and one line. The hero compacts, the health widget widens enough for its caption to fit one line, and the KPI/cashflow sections shift up slightly with more content visible. Populated states keep the original subtitle via :has() and new i18n keys exist in TR/EN. No clipping, truncation or contrast regressions.
